name: shinchantw_cbt_payment_churn_fight_timing_20260804_110016_586202
sql:
/*
截至 2026-08-03 的付费、观察性流失、晶钻购买及主线挑战时段。

关键口径：
1) 主线挑战：stage_fight 且 a_rst[1].key = 1001。
2) 某关“挑战失败/卡关”：该关累计挑战 >= 2 次，且在观察截止前未进入 ID 更高的主线关。
   这是代理口径：没有独立的胜负字段时，以“进入下一关”视为完成当前关。
3) 观察性流失：2026-08-03 当天没有任何非黑名单事件；不是永久流失判定。
4) 游戏时长：同账号相邻非 app 事件间隔 0~119 秒的累计分钟，与既有日报口径一致。
*/
WITH Cfg AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' AS start_date, DATE '2026-08-03' AS end_date
),
Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
Events AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        e."#event_time" AS event_time,
        e."$part_date" AS event_date,
        e."#event_name" AS event_name,
        e."$part_event" AS part_event,
        e.a_rst,
        e.shop_item,
        e.product_id,
        e.pay_amount,
        e.pay_currency,
        e.sandbox,
        e.is_freebuy
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Cfg c
    LEFT JOIN Blacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002', '91110', '91111')
),
StageEvents AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        event_time,
        TRY_CAST(a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) AS stage_id
    FROM Events
    WHERE event_name = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND TRY_CAST(a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL
),
StageNames AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") AS stage_name
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765
    GROUP BY 1
),
FirstPay AS (
    SELECT account_id, pay_time, product_id, pay_amount, pay_currency
    FROM (
        SELECT
            account_id,
            event_time AS pay_time,
            product_id,
            pay_amount,
            pay_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time) AS rn
        FROM Events
        WHERE part_event = 'charge'
          AND (sandbox IS NULL OR sandbox = FALSE)
          AND (is_freebuy IS NULL OR is_freebuy = FALSE)
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
PrePayStages AS (
    SELECT p.account_id, p.pay_time, s.stage_id, s.event_time
    FROM FirstPay p
    JOIN StageEvents s ON p.account_id = s.account_id AND s.event_time <= p.pay_time
),
PrePayStageAgg AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        pay_time,
        stage_id,
        COUNT(*) AS attempt_times,
        MIN(event_time) AS first_attempt_time,
        MAX(event_time) AS last_attempt_time
    FROM PrePayStages
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
PrePayFlags AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        MAX(stage_id) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, pay_time) AS max_stage_before_pay,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, pay_time ORDER BY stage_id DESC) AS current_stage_rn
    FROM PrePayStageAgg a
),
FirstPayDetail AS (
    SELECT
        p.account_id,
        p.pay_time,
        COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", CONCAT('未映射商品(', CAST(p.product_id AS VARCHAR), ')')) AS first_product_name,
        COALESCE(cur.stage_id, 0) AS current_stage_id,
        COALESCE(sn.stage_name, '创角后尚未挑战主线') AS current_stage_name,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(cur.attempt_times, 0) >= 2 AND cur.stage_id = cur.max_stage_before_pay THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS current_stage_failed_before_pay,
        COALESCE(cur.attempt_times, 0) AS current_stage_attempt_times,
        COALESCE(any_fail.has_failed_stage, 0) AS has_any_failed_stage_before_pay
    FROM FirstPay p
    LEFT JOIN PrePayFlags cur ON p.account_id = cur.account_id AND p.pay_time = cur.pay_time AND cur.current_stage_rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN StageNames sn ON cur.stage_id = sn.stage_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp ON TRY_CAST(p.product_id AS INTEGER) = TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, pay_time, 1 AS has_failed_stage
        FROM PrePayFlags
        WHERE attempt_times >= 2
        GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) any_fail ON p.account_id = any_fail.account_id AND p.pay_time = any_fail.pay_time
),
EventGaps AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        event_time,
        DATE_DIFF('second', CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP), LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time)) AS next_gap_seconds
    FROM Events
    WHERE event_name NOT LIKE '%app%'
),
UserLifecycle AS (
    SELECT
        e.account_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS first_event_time,
        MAX(e.event_time) AS last_event_time,
        MAX(CAST(e.event_date AS DATE)) AS last_event_date,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.next_gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN g.next_gap_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2) AS game_minutes
    FROM Events e
    LEFT JOIN EventGaps g ON e.account_id = g.account_id AND e.event_time = g.event_time
    GROUP BY 1
),
LastStageAgg AS (
    SELECT
        s.account_id,
        s.stage_id,
        COUNT(*) AS attempt_times,
        MIN(s.event_time) AS first_attempt_time,
        MAX(s.event_time) AS last_attempt_time,
        MAX(s.stage_id) OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id) AS max_stage_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id ORDER BY s.stage_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM StageEvents s
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ObservedChurn AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        l.first_event_time,
        l.last_event_time,
        l.game_minutes,
        COALESCE(s.stage_id, 0) AS last_stage_id,
        COALESCE(n.stage_name, '未挑战主线') AS last_stage_name,
        COALESCE(s.attempt_times, 0) AS last_stage_attempt_times,
        s.first_attempt_time AS stage_first_attempt_time,
        s.last_attempt_time AS stage_last_attempt_time,
        CASE WHEN s.attempt_times >= 2 AND s.stage_id = s.max_stage_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stuck_at_last_stage
    FROM UserLifecycle l
    CROSS JOIN Cfg c
    LEFT JOIN LastStageAgg s ON l.account_id = s.account_id AND s.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN StageNames n ON s.stage_id = n.stage_id
    WHERE l.last_event_date < c.end_date
),
GemSpend AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) AS event_second,
        SUM(
            REDUCE(
                FILTER(a_rst, x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT) = 10206
                    AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE) > TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),
                0.0,
                (s, x) -> s + ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE), 0)),
                s -> s
            )
        ) / 100.0 AS gem_spent
    FROM Events
    WHERE part_event = 'item_change'
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
CashPurchase AS (
    SELECT
        '现金付费' AS purchase_type,
        COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", CONCAT('未映射商品(', CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR), ')')) AS product_name,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_times,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.account_id) AS purchase_users,
        ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(ex.exchange, 1)), 2) AS cash_revenue_usd,
        CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) AS gem_spent
    FROM Events e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange ex ON e.event_date = ex.ex_date AND e.pay_currency = ex.currency
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER) = TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE e.part_event = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
GemPurchase AS (
    SELECT
        '晶钻购买' AS purchase_type,
        COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", CONCAT('未映射商品(', CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS VARCHAR), ')')) AS product_name,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_times,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.account_id) AS purchase_users,
        CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) AS cash_revenue_usd,
        ROUND(SUM(g.gem_spent), 2) AS gem_spent
    FROM Events e
    JOIN GemSpend g ON e.account_id = g.account_id
        AND CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e.event_time AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) = g.event_second
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp ON TRY_CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS INTEGER) = TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE e.part_event = 'shop_buy'
      AND g.gem_spent > 0
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
FightHour AS (
    SELECT
        HOUR(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) AS hour_of_day,
        COUNT(*) AS fight_events,
        COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS fight_users
    FROM StageEvents
    GROUP BY 1
),
OutputRows AS (
    SELECT
        'first_pay_detail' AS module,
        CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR) AS account_id,
        CAST(pay_time AS VARCHAR) AS time_value,
        first_product_name AS dimension_1,
        current_stage_name AS dimension_2,
        current_stage_id AS metric_1,
        current_stage_attempt_times AS metric_2,
        current_stage_failed_before_pay AS metric_3,
        has_any_failed_stage_before_pay AS metric_4,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS metric_5
    FROM FirstPayDetail
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'observed_churn_detail', CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(last_event_time AS VARCHAR), last_stage_name,
        CASE WHEN stuck_at_last_stage = 1 THEN '卡关' ELSE '未判定卡关' END,
        last_stage_id, last_stage_attempt_times, stuck_at_last_stage, game_minutes, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
    FROM ObservedChurn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'observed_churn_stage_summary', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), last_stage_name,
        CASE WHEN stuck_at_last_stage = 1 THEN '卡关' ELSE '未判定卡关' END,
        last_stage_id, COUNT(*), SUM(stuck_at_last_stage), ROUND(AVG(game_minutes), 2), ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE(game_minutes, 0.5), 2)
    FROM ObservedChurn
    GROUP BY 1,4,5,6
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'purchase_summary', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), purchase_type, product_name,
        purchase_times, purchase_users, cash_revenue_usd, gem_spent, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM CashPurchase UNION ALL SELECT * FROM GemPurchase)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'fight_hourly', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(hour_of_day AS VARCHAR), '主线挑战 stage_fight', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
        fight_events, fight_users, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
    FROM FightHour
)
SELECT
    module AS "数据模块",
    account_id AS "账号ID",
    time_value AS "时间",
    dimension_1 AS "维度1",
    dimension_2 AS "维度2",
    metric_1 AS "指标1",
    metric_2 AS "指标2",
    metric_3 AS "指标3",
    metric_4 AS "指标4",
    metric_5 AS "指标5"
FROM OutputRows
ORDER BY "数据模块", "指标1" DESC, "指标2" DESC;
